**Role description**  

Product Owner (Mid\-Level)


**Experience Required:** 3\-5 Years **Job Type:** Full\-Time



Job Summary



We are looking for a **mid\-level Product Owner** with 3\-5 years of experience to own the product backlog for one or more product areas, translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, and work closely with cross\-functional Agile teams to deliver value iteratively. The ideal candidate is comfortable balancing stakeholder priorities, technical feasibility, and customer needs to keep the team focused on the right work at the right time.



Key Responsibilities


* Own, maintain, and continuously groom the **product backlog**, ensuring it is prioritized by business value and clearly understood by the development team
* Write clear, well\-structured **user stories** with detailed acceptance criteria and definition of done
* Define and communicate **sprint goals** in collaboration with the Scrum Master and development team
* Act as the primary point of contact for **stakeholder requirements**, gathering input from business, customers, and internal teams
* Participate actively in **sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives**
* Partner with the Product Manager (or equivalent) to align sprint\-level execution with the broader **product roadmap and vision**
* Make day\-to\-day prioritization trade\-off decisions, balancing new features, technical debt, and bug fixes
* Conduct **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** and validate that delivered features meet business requirements before release
* Work closely with **UX/UI designers** to ensure requirements translate into intuitive user experiences
* Communicate progress, blockers, and release timelines clearly to stakeholders and leadership
* Analyze customer feedback, usage data, and support trends to inform backlog decisions
* Define and track key product metrics/KPIs to measure feature success post\-release
* Support release planning and go\-to\-market coordination for new features
* Collaborate with engineering to understand technical constraints and dependencies affecting scope or timelines


Required Skills \& Qualifications


* 3\-5 years of experience as a **Product Owner**, Business Analyst, or in a related Agile product role
* Solid working knowledge of **Agile/Scrum methodology**, including backlog management, story writing, and sprint ceremonies
* Hands\-on experience with Agile tooling — **JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps**, or similar
* Strong **stakeholder management** and cross\-functional communication skills
* Comfortable engaging with technical teams — working understanding of APIs, system architecture, or data flows sufficient to have informed conversations with engineers
* Data\-informed approach to prioritization, with basic familiarity with analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Power BI, or similar)
* Experience translating ambiguous business needs into clear, testable requirements
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to stakeholders


Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have


* **CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner)** or **PSPO (Professional Scrum Product Owner)** certification
* Experience with roadmap planning tools (e.g., Aha!, ProductPlan, Productboard)
* Exposure to A/B testing or experimentation frameworks
* Basic SQL skills for independent data pulls/analysis
* Familiarity with UX/UI design principles and design handoff processes
* Domain experience relevant to the hiring team's industry (e.g., fintech, e\-commerce, SaaS, healthcare)


Soft Skills


* Strong communication and interpersonal skills across both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Analytical, detail\-oriented, and comfortable making prioritization trade\-offs
* Ability to influence without direct authority and align diverse stakeholders
* Adaptable and comfortable operating with some ambiguity in a fast\-paced environment

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Data
jobs.description:
**About Fairground**


Fairground is a B2B GTM data platform. We ingest, enrich, and structure millions of company and contact records across verticals, and turn them into reliable go\-to\-market signal inside our products. Data is the product — and how well we build the pipeline behind it is the business.

**Why this role exists**


Right now our data work — ingestion, enrichment, vertical expansion, quality — is spread across engineers with no single owner defining *what* to build or *in what order*. This role owns that. You'll be the person who turns a backlog of data projects into a sequenced, shipped roadmap, and who makes sure engineering builds the right thing the first time.


This is a high\-leverage hire: the projects you unblock touch nearly every workflow in the product.

**What you'll do**

* Own the data platform roadmap end to end — ingestion, enrichment, matching, vertical data models, and the sync between our warehouse, CRM, and products
* Turn ambiguous data problems into fully\-specced, buildable projects
* Prioritize ruthlessly across a large backlog: which verticals, which data sources, which quality fixes come first, and why
* Own the data quality feedback loop — define how we catch bad data before customers see it, and drive the process to fix it
* Evaluate and manage third\-party data and enrichment vendors — coverage, quality, cost — and make build\-vs\-buy calls
* Keep an eye on the cost side: AI and enrichment spend is a growing driver of COGS, and roadmap decisions move that number
* Partner tightly with engineering, design, and GTM to ship — and be the connective tissue between what customers need and what the pipeline can deliver

**What we're looking for**

* 5\+ years in product management, with real depth on data products, data infrastructure, or technical/platform PM work
* Technical fluency: you can read a schema, reason about pipelines and data models, and hold your own with engineers on trade\-offs
* A track record of shipping, turning messy, ambiguous problem spaces into sequenced roadmaps that get built
* Strong instincts for data quality and entity resolution: what "good data" means and how to defend it at scale
* Experience with third\-party data vendors or enrichment is a strong plus
* Comfort operating with high autonomy in a fast\-moving, early\-stage environment
* Bonus: B2B GTM / sales\-tech domain experience

**Why Fairground**


You'll own the roadmap for the layer that *is* the company. It's the highest\-leverage seat on the product team — what you unblock ripples across the entire platform. High ownership, direct customer and revenue impact, and a team moving fast.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, Planning Intelligence
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Customer experience is at the heart of all we do at Amazon, as we strive to be Earth's most customer\-centric company. Amazon Customer Service (CS) is at the forefront of customer experience, working relentlessly to provide customers a convenient, high quality, and delightful experience — across all of our CS channels — in every interaction.  

  

Within CS, Network Solutions is responsible for designing, planning, and operating the world's largest customer service network — building intelligent, adaptive systems that anticipate demand, match customers to optimal experiences. We are transforming CS from a manually operated, reactive model into an AI\-native ecosystem that makes CS a growth driver and competitive advantage for Amazon.  

  

We are seeking a Software Development Engineer (SDE2\) to join Planning Intelligence (PI) — the AI\-native brain of Amazon CS. Our team builds the predictive intelligence that defines how CS creates value: forecasting demand at granular levels in real\-time, powering autonomous planning and what\-if scenario simulations, shaping network design, and optimizing resource allocation to deliver the customer and business outcomes that matter most.  

  

The ideal candidate will own the design, implementation, and delivery of software that enables these capabilities. You will build distributed systems that plan autonomously, simulate scenarios to evaluate tradeoffs, and optimize resource allocation across the network — directly shaping how millions of customers experience Amazon's support.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Scope \& Software Design: You deliver software features and improvements to major portions of your team's software — spanning new development, refactoring, and deprecation. You design solutions that enable new capabilities or improve existing systems, aligned with your team's long\-term architectural strategy. You work with customers and stakeholders to understand business value and ensure you deliver the right solutions. You document how your team's software is constructed, tested, and operated, and actively train new teammates.  

  

Execution \& Operational Excellence: You are a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle — scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, and maintenance. You don't settle for the status quo, routinely identifying opportunities to improve your team's operations. You actively participate in code reviews, providing meaningful feedback to senior engineers and seeking early feedback on your own work. You ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved with permanent fixes.  

  

Problem Solving \& Impact: You work on difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. You make effective priority tradeoffs between feature development and operational work. You mentor other engineers and resolve disagreements through constructive dialog.  

  

A day in the life  

You design and deliver software features that power planning and optimization for Amazon's global customer service network. You write and review code daily, contribute to design discussions, and make tradeoffs between speed and quality. You collaborate with Scientists, Product Managers, and business teams to turn requirements into well\-designed, maintainable software. You own your services end\-to\-end \- from design through operations \- and when things break, you dig deep to find root causes and drive permanent resolution. You mentor teammates, improve team processes, and keep your skills current. Your work directly impacts how millions of customers experience Amazon's support.  

  

About the team  

Planning Intelligence is the world leader in providing cost\-optimal, AI\-driven solutions that enable customers to get best\-in\-class human support while raising the bar on associate experience. We are responsible for: 1\) Planning customer support staffing through autonomous, AI\-native systems. 2\) Preserving customer experience through intelligent, outcome\-based network planning. 3\) Ensuring optimal costs through real\-time resource optimization. Our team crafts comprehensive workforce management plans by combining predictive intelligence, scenario simulation, and scientific optimization \- moving from reactive, manual planning to systems that continuously learn, adapt, and deliver the right outcomes at scale.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Data
jobs.description:
**About Fairground**
 Fairground is a B2B GTM data platform. We ingest, enrich, and structure millions of company and contact records across verticals, and turn them into reliable go\-to\-market signal inside our products. Data is the product — and how well we build the pipeline behind it is the business.
   

  

**Why this role exists**
 Right now our data work — ingestion, enrichment, vertical expansion, quality — is spread across engineers with no single owner defining
 *what* 
 to build or
 *in what order* 
 . This role owns that. You'll be the person who turns a backlog of data projects into a sequenced, shipped roadmap, and who makes sure engineering builds the right thing the first time.
   

  

 This is a high\-leverage hire: the projects you unblock touch nearly every workflow in the product.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own the data platform roadmap end to end — ingestion, enrichment, matching, vertical data models, and the sync between our warehouse, CRM, and products
* Turn ambiguous data problems into fully\-specced, buildable projects
* Prioritize ruthlessly across a large backlog: which verticals, which data sources, which quality fixes come first, and why
* Own the data quality feedback loop — define how we catch bad data before customers see it, and drive the process to fix it
* Evaluate and manage third\-party data and enrichment vendors — coverage, quality, cost — and make build\-vs\-buy calls
* Keep an eye on the cost side: AI and enrichment spend is a growing driver of COGS, and roadmap decisions move that number
* Partner tightly with engineering, design, and GTM to ship — and be the connective tissue between what customers need and what the pipeline can deliver


**What We're Looking For**
* 5\+ years in product management, with real depth on data products, data infrastructure, or technical/platform PM work
* Technical fluency: you can read a schema, reason about pipelines and data models, and hold your own with engineers on trade\-offs
* A track record of shipping, turning messy, ambiguous problem spaces into sequenced roadmaps that get built
* Strong instincts for data quality and entity resolution: what "good data" means and how to defend it at scale
* Experience with third\-party data vendors or enrichment is a strong plus
* Comfort operating with high autonomy in a fast\-moving, early\-stage environment
* Bonus: B2B GTM / sales\-tech domain experience


**Why Fairground**
 You'll own the roadmap for the layer that
 *is* 
 the company. It's the highest\-leverage seat on the product team — what you unblock ripples across the entire platform. High ownership, direct customer and revenue impact, and a team moving fast.

**Role description**  

This is a Test scenario creation and execution\-focused (hands\-on) contract role for a professional with **at least 10 years of experience**. You will be dedicated to verifying applications built upon Salesforce, Bullhorn, C\+\+ and can largely be accessed via API as well as different interfaces. Your primary focus (\~75%) will be safeguarding quality through meticulous test design, complex system integration testing (SIT), and manual exploratory testing. The remaining (\~25%) of your time will be spent creating API tests for testing the integration of application Iplan with x\-one.


Alongside execution, you will serve as a supportive senior presence on the test floor.


**What will you do within the x\-one program?**

**Functional \& End\-to\-End Testing Core (\~75% of the role):**

* **Test Script Design:** Independently draft advanced test scripts in Gherkin within TestRail based on global release notes and local user stories.
* **Hands\-on Execution:** Execute deep manual functional, configuration, and exploratory tests to validate business\-critical flows on Salesforce and iPlan
* **Integration \& SIT Validation:** Validate complex local connections (such as API\-driven endpoints via Boomi or Apigee) to ensure data integrity across the entire local E2E chain.
* **Defect Management:** Log and track formal software defects thoroughly inside Jira, acting as a strong sparring partner for developers during re\-testing.
* **Acceptance Support:** Actively support local business streams and users during Functional Acceptance Testing (FAT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing test data and helping guide execution.
* **Team Mentorship:** Support, train, and coach junior and medior QA testers on\-the\-job to enhance their testing techniques and functional analysis skills.

**Test Automation Support (\~25% of the role):**

* **Risk\-Based Selection:** Analyze delivered epics to identify the highest\-risk business scenarios and tag them within TestRail for inclusion in the automated regression suite.


 **Pipeline Execution:** Trigger and run automated smoke tests and API test scripts (using tools like ) immediately following environment deployments to ensure platform stability. **Automation Collaboration:** Collaborate closely with dedicated Test Automation Engineers, flagging when existing automated scripts require refactoring due to changes in application UI or workflows.
* **API \& Microservice Savvy****:**Deep experience with automated testing of REST APIs and navigating a microservices/domain services architecture (using libraries such as like RestAssured or similar).

**Who will you collaborate with?**

* **Reporting line:** You will report directly to the local Test Manager / Domain Manager of the x\-one program.
* **The Project Team:** Work daily alongside internal QA Testers, dedicated Automation Engineers, Developers, and Product Owners within your agile squad.
* **Stakeholders:** Connect with local Dutch IT domain experts (RGN IT), global business flow leads, and global QA counterparts to sync on release expectations.

* **Experience:** A minimum of **10 years of proven experience** as a Test Analyst or QA Engineer in large\-scale, complex enterprise environments.

* **Analytical Mindset:** Strong capability in applying risk\-based testing methodologies, such as Product Risk Analysis or Risk Poker frameworks.

* **Languages:** Fluent at writing and speaking in English (essential for navigating local integrations and global organizational alignment).

jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience managing the unique complexities and fast\-paced life\-cycle of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) software development projects.
* Experience in leading Agile transformations, with a track record of coaching and upskilling engineering teams in Agile delivery and ceremonies.
* Ability to apply program management fundamentals on technical cross\-functional projects (planning, execution, estimation, risk management, stakeholder management).

**About the job**
-----------------


A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers. The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Own and drive the planning and execution of complex, cross\-functional engineering efforts within a specific domain or product area.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of Agile ceremonies and help software teams adopt and mature their Agile practices to improve efficiency.
* Implement governance structures for prioritization and execution within your assigned area to ensure alignment with key success metrics.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with technical and non\-technical stakeholders across teams to ensure project alignment and buy\-in.
* Use sound judgment to drive project planning, scheduling, execution, and communication, building consensus among team members and partners.

jobs.title: Lead Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Lead Product Owner (LPO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is responsible for
 **end‑to‑end ownership, consistency, and execution excellence across multiple data, analytics, and reporting products or domains** 
 . This role ensures alignment between business priorities, product strategy, and delivery execution.
   

  

 The Lead Product Owner acts as the
 **central accountability point across a portfolio of related products** 
 , coaching and guiding Product Owners, establishing standards, and partnering closely with Program Management, Data Engineering, and Governance to deliver predictable, high‑quality outcomes.
   

  

 This role is critical to enabling
 **product‑led execution at scale** 
 within the CDO.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio‑Level Product Ownership**
* Own the overall product vision and execution strategy across a defined product portfolio or domain (e.g., Reporting, Self‑Service Analytics, Finance Analytics, Data Platforms).
* Ensure each product has:
+ A clear purpose and roadmap
+ Defined success metrics
+ Consistent experience and standards

* Act as the final decision authority on prioritization, scope tradeoffs, and acceptance across related products.


**Leadership \& Coaching**
* Lead, mentor, and coach Product Owners to ensure consistent product ownership practices and decision quality.
* Set and enforce standards for backlog quality, roadmap clarity, and stakeholder communication.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex prioritization, dependency, or scope conflicts.
* Raise the overall product ownership maturity across CDO.


**Stakeholder Alignment \& Business Partnership**
* Serve as an interface between CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Translate enterprise priorities into sequenced, realistic roadmaps.
* Manage competing stakeholder demands by making transparent, value‑based trade‑offs.
* Ensure stakeholders have confidence in what will be delivered, when, and why.


**Roadmap, Backlog \& Delivery Governance**
* Maintain a portfolio‑level roadmap, aligned with capacity, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure Product Owners maintain well‑defined, ready backlogs that support predictable delivery.
* Partner with Program Managers and Scrum Masters to:
+ Align sprint and release plans
+ Surface risks and constraints early
+ Manage cross‑team dependencies

* Ensure delivery adheres to CDO governance, readiness, and release standards.


**Quality, Governance \& Trust**
* Partner with Data Governance, Architecture, and Platform teams to:
+ Enforce consistent KPI definitions and semantic standards
+ Uphold data quality, lineage, and trust expectations
+ Ensure security and compliance requirements are met

* Ensure products are operationally ready and supported post‑release.


**Value Realization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and track adoption, usage, and value metrics across the product portfolio.
* Ensure products deliver measurable business impact, not just functionality.
* Identify opportunities to:
+ Simplify or consolidate products
+ Reduce technical or vendor dependency
+ Improve scalability and user experience

* Continuously refine product direction based on feedback and performance insights.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 7\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Product Management, Business Analysis, or Analytics/Data‑centric leadership roles.
* Proven experience owning multiple products or domains in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data, analytics, reporting, and BI platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
* Experience leading or mentoring other Product Owners or equivalent roles.


**Preferred**
* Experience within a Chief Data Office, Analytics COE, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with platforms such as Databricks, Power BI, semantic models, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience modernizing legacy reporting or analytics platforms.
* Background in professional services or financial services environments.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Thinks and acts portfolio‑first, not story‑by‑story.
* Brings clarity, structure, and discipline to ambiguity.
* Comfortable making—and defending—trade‑off decisions.
* Focused on outcomes, adoption, and trust, not just delivery.
* Acts as a role model for product ownership maturity.


**Role Relationships (Clarity of Accountability)**
* Lead Product Owner: Defines long‑term strategy, investment priorities, and value realization. Owns execution alignment, product standards, and delivery outcomes across a portfolio.
* Product Owners: Own day‑to‑day product execution and backlogs within specific domains.
* Program Managers: Own delivery coordination, milestones, and dependency management.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Lead Product Owner ensures CDO can
 **scale product‑led execution without chaos** 
 , reducing reliance on individual heroics while increasing predictability, trust, and impact across enterprise data and analytics investments.

jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
   

  

 The Product Owner partners closely with
 **Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams** 
 to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
 **clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact** 
 in a complex, enterprise data environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership \& Accountability**
* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.


**Stakeholder Engagement \& Business Alignment**
* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.


**Backlog, Roadmap \& Delivery Management**
* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.


**Governance, Quality \& Standards**
* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:
+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.


**Adoption, Value \& Continuous Improvement**
* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.


**Required**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 5\+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.


**Preferred**
* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.


**Leadership Behaviors \& Expectations**
* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.
* Trusted partner to both business leaders and technical teams.


**Why This Role Matters**
 The Product Owner is a
 **critical enabler of CDO’s product‑led operating model** 
 , ensuring that data and analytics investments deliver consistent, trusted, and measurable value to the firm—while reducing dependency on informal workarounds, fragmented ownership, and vendor‑driven execution.

* Exceptional communication skills – written and verbal – and are able to communicate with our members, internal stakeholders \& regulatory bodies if required

### **What you'll get in return:**


* 25 days paid annual leave
* 3 paid days off for volunteering or L\&D activities
* Extended maternity and paternity leave covered by the company
* Personal L\&D budget
* Additional health \& dental insurance
* Mental wellbeing platform
* Fully covered Multisports card
* Food vouchers
* Snacks, light food, drinks in the office
* WFH equipment allowance
* Sabbatical Leave

### **Tidean Ways of Working**



At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in\-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.



While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face\-to\-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team\-building, where we encourage regular in\-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

### **TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE**



At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently\-abled status. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members' diverse needs and lives.

**Opportunity Overview:**



We are seeking a highly analytical, detail\-oriented, and results\-driven Data Analyst to join our dynamic Payment Integrity team. This role is critical in transforming complex healthcare claims, provider, operational, and financial data into actionable insights that improve business performance, optimize audit outcomes, and drive operational excellence.



The ideal candidate will be highly skilled at uncovering patterns in data, connecting the dots across multiple data sources, identifying process inefficiencies, and recommending corrective actions. You will partner closely with engineering, operations, audit, finance, product, and leadership teams to support strategic decision\-making through advanced analytics, dashboarding, forecasting, automation, and performance measurement. This opportunity is ideal for a self\-motivated professional who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and enjoys solving complex business problems through data.


**What you'll do:**


* Analyze large healthcare datasets including medical claims, audit outcomes, provider data, reimbursements, appeals, invoices, outreach activity, and operational performance metrics to identify trends, anomalies, and business opportunities.
* Build analytics to support provider outreach effectiveness, response tracking, follow\-up performance, and provider abrasion control initiatives.
* Monitor and improve end\-to\-end audit lifecycle SLAs, turnaround time (TAT), queue aging, throughput, and productivity metrics.
* Perform invoice reconciliation by validating recoveries, fees, payments, billing outputs, and financial reporting accuracy.
* Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reporting using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools.
* Develop automated daily, weekly, and monthly reports for operational, financial, and executive stakeholders.
* Be flexible and responsive in generating ad hoc reports and business analysis based on evolving operational priorities.
* Ensure all reports, dashboards, and published metrics are accurate, reconciled, and aligned across systems.
* Create profiling reports for auditors, providers, clients, claims inventory, productivity, and recoveries; continuously monitor for changes, trends, and performance drift.
* Detect operational drift, unusual patterns, leakage points, and inefficiencies; recommend corrective actions to improve overall process efficiency.
* Uncover hidden patterns in data and connect insights across multiple sources to support business decisions.
* Perform root cause analysis on missed recoveries, SLA breaches, provider abrasion, operational delays, and reporting variances.
* Use advanced analytics and forecasting to support staffing models, productivity planning, and business growth initiatives.
* Create and optimize complex queries, data models, and automated workflows using SQL and Python.
* Partner closely with operations, audit, finance, product, and leadership teams to support strategic decision\-making through analytics and reporting.
* Maintain data governance standards and adhere to HIPAA and company privacy policies.


**Required Qualifications:**


* **3\+ years of experience** in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence preferably healthcare Claims Analytics, or Payment Integrity Analytics.
* Advanced expertise in SQL including complex joins, CTEs, stored procedures, optimization, and large dataset handling.
* Strong hands\-on expertise in Python for automation, reporting workflows, data transformation, and advanced analytics.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets including pivots, lookups, formulas, data validation, and dashboards.
* Experience with BI/reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau.
* Proven ability to ensure reporting accuracy, reconcile numbers, and maintain trust in published metrics.
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to uncover patterns in data and connect the dots across multiple sources.
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on data quality and accuracy.
* Experience creating automated reporting suites, KPI dashboards, and executive scorecards.
* Experience monitoring productivity, SLA, TAT, queue health, financial metrics, and operational performance.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills and ability to work with operations, audit, finance, product, and leadership teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to translate complex findings into clear business recommendations.
* Strong prioritization, ownership mindset, and problem\-solving capability.
* Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or related field.


**Nice to Haves**


* Knowledge of AWS services like Lambda, S3, EC2 and Textract.
* Strong experience in Payment Integrity operations, healthcare claims data, provider analytics, audit workflows, and financial reporting.
* Should have Intellectual curiosity to learn new things.
* Familiarity with version control tools such as Git.
* Experience using Jira for tracking requests, sprint planning, and workflow management.

* Hyderabad (Nacharam), Telangana: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

jobs.description:
**Opportunity Overview:**



We are seeking a highly analytical, detail\-oriented, and results\-driven Data Analyst to join our dynamic Payment Integrity team. This role is critical in transforming complex healthcare claims, provider, operational, and financial data into actionable insights that improve business performance, optimize audit outcomes, and drive operational excellence.



The ideal candidate will be highly skilled at uncovering patterns in data, connecting the dots across multiple data sources, identifying process inefficiencies, and recommending corrective actions. You will partner closely with engineering, operations, audit, finance, product, and leadership teams to support strategic decision\-making through advanced analytics, dashboarding, forecasting, automation, and performance measurement. This opportunity is ideal for a self\-motivated professional who thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and enjoys solving complex business problems through data.


**What you'll do:**


* Analyze large healthcare datasets including medical claims, audit outcomes, provider data, reimbursements, appeals, invoices, outreach activity, and operational performance metrics to identify trends, anomalies, and business opportunities.
* Build analytics to support provider outreach effectiveness, response tracking, follow\-up performance, and provider abrasion control initiatives.
* Monitor and improve end\-to\-end audit lifecycle SLAs, turnaround time (TAT), queue aging, throughput, and productivity metrics.
* Perform invoice reconciliation by validating recoveries, fees, payments, billing outputs, and financial reporting accuracy.
* Build and maintain dashboards, scorecards, and KPI reporting using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools.
* Develop automated daily, weekly, and monthly reports for operational, financial, and executive stakeholders.
* Be flexible and responsive in generating ad hoc reports and business analysis based on evolving operational priorities.
* Ensure all reports, dashboards, and published metrics are accurate, reconciled, and aligned across systems.
* Create profiling reports for auditors, providers, clients, claims inventory, productivity, and recoveries; continuously monitor for changes, trends, and performance drift.
* Detect operational drift, unusual patterns, leakage points, and inefficiencies; recommend corrective actions to improve overall process efficiency.
* Uncover hidden patterns in data and connect insights across multiple sources to support business decisions.
* Perform root cause analysis on missed recoveries, SLA breaches, provider abrasion, operational delays, and reporting variances.
* Use advanced analytics and forecasting to support staffing models, productivity planning, and business growth initiatives.

* Partner closely with operations, audit, finance, product, and leadership teams to support strategic decision\-making through analytics and reporting.
* Maintain data governance standards and adhere to HIPAA and company privacy policies.

* Strong hands\-on expertise in Python for automation, reporting workflows, data transformation, and advanced analytics.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets including pivots, lookups, formulas, data validation, and dashboards.
* Experience with BI/reporting tools such as Power BI, Tableau.
* Proven ability to ensure reporting accuracy, reconcile numbers, and maintain trust in published metrics.
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to uncover patterns in data and connect the dots across multiple sources.
* High attention to detail with a strong focus on data quality and accuracy.
* Experience creating automated reporting suites, KPI dashboards, and executive scorecards.
* Experience monitoring productivity, SLA, TAT, queue health, financial metrics, and operational performance.
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills and ability to work with operations, audit, finance, product, and leadership teams.
* Excellent communication skills with ability to translate complex findings into clear business recommendations.
* Strong prioritization, ownership mindset, and problem\-solving capability.
* Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or related field.


**Nice to Haves**


* Knowledge of AWS services like Lambda, S3, EC2 and Textract.
* Strong experience in Payment Integrity operations, healthcare claims data, provider analytics, audit workflows, and financial reporting.
* Should have Intellectual curiosity to learn new things.
* Familiarity with version control tools such as Git.
* Experience using Jira for tracking requests, sprint planning, and workflow management.

**India \- Bangalore**

Professional Services/Full time/Onsite

  

Guidewire is seeking a Senior Product Engineer to join our Professional Services AI Engineering team in Bangalore. In our Core \& Satellite model, you will work on the development side of our Strike Teams — reporting to the Engineering Manager and pairing with a Senior AI Engineer to deliver production\-grade, customer\-facing AI features end\-to\-end.  

  

This is a hands\-on senior engineering role. You own the dev work for your features end\-to\-end, build using AI coding tools like Claude Code, and operate inside platform blueprints set by the Platform Architect, AI Architect, and QA Architect — so you can focus on shipping the product rather than re\-inventing infrastructure.
Job Description
End\-to\-End Feature Delivery: Own the dev work on a Strike Team — REST APIs, frontend wiring, feature logic, and integration with AI components — for one high\-complexity or strategic AI productization project at a time.
Technical Execution: Make day\-to\-day implementation calls, contribute to design reviews, and make sound trade\-off decisions on your features; escalate cross\-cutting concerns to the Engineering Manager.
AI Integration: Partner with your AI Engineer to bring LLM\-based components into production paths — prompt invocation, response handling, fallbacks, observability. You'll shape how these components are integrated, collaborate on the design decisions that affect the product, and bring the AI Architect in on the deeper algorithmic calls.
Platform \& Standards Consumption: Build on top of the team’s d CI/CD, vector DB, auth, QA, and UI/UX foundations. Push back to the horizontal layer when something is missing or wrong.
Code Quality \& Mentorship: Set a high bar for code review, testing, and engineering hygiene through your own work. Mentor the Consultant Product Engineer and the AI pairing partners.

KPIs \& Success Metrics
End\-to\-end delivery of high\-complexity or strategic projects on schedule.
Quality bar upheld: review standards, test coverage, and observability for owned features.
Reliable AI integration — LLM\-backed paths with sound fallbacks and acceptable latency.
Mentorship impact: growth of the Consultant Product Engineer and AI pairing partners.
Platform feedback loop: gaps surfaced and resolved with the horizontal teams.

Key Skills \& Experience
Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience: 8\+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend or full\-stack production development.
Technical Proficiency:
– Expert\-level skills in at least one production backend language (Java, Python, or TypeScript) and the surrounding ecosystem.
– Strong REST API design experience, database modeling (SQL and at least one NoSQL store), and event\-driven patterns.
– Working knowledge of frontend frameworks (React or equivalent) sufficient to wire UI components into your APIs.
– Working understanding of LLM APIs and how AI features are integrated — prompt invocation, streaming, retries, fallbacks. You'll partner with AI specialists on the modeling and data\-science work, contributing to the integration design and knowing when to bring in the AI Architect.
– Experience with coding assistants (Claude Code, Copilot).
Engineering Excellence: Track record of shipping production features end\-to\-end. Strong CI/CD, Git workflow, automated testing, and observability habits.
Domain Context: (Preferred) Experience with enterprise software, regulated industries, or multi\-tenant SaaS.

Preferred Skills \& Experience
Cloud Infrastructure: Hands\-on AWS experience (Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, RDS).
AI Productization: Experience shipping LLM\-powered or RAG\-based features into production.
Guidewire Knowledge: Prior experience with Guidewire InsuranceSuite or Guidewire Cloud is a significant plus.
Team Leadership: Prior experience leading small teams or owning a feature area end\-to\-end.
Interested in this position?
  
About Guidewire
Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. Wild are on a mission to remove single\-use plastic from the bathroom, armed with our refillable, natural and scent\-sational deodorants, body wash, and lip balm – and we’re only just getting started. We launched in 2020 and as a high\-growth company we’re already one of Europe’s fastest growing start\-ups.  

  

**Role Summary:**  

The AI Developer / Full Stack Engineer is the primary builder of Wild's autonomous agents and the applications around them. Where the business today uses LLMs in a chat\-based way, this role designs and ships agents that take action — calling tools and APIs, executing multi\-step workflows, and operating with minimal human intervention.  

You will work end\-to\-end: designing agent logic in Google Agent Builder, integrating with Snowflake and business systems, and building the interfaces and services that let users interact with and supervise agents. This is a deeply hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys turning ambiguous business problems into working, reliable software.  

Quality and trust are central. You will build with evaluation, observability, and guardrails in mind, ensuring agents behave predictably, fail safely, and keep humans in control where it matters. You will iterate quickly, but always toward production\-grade outcomes.

* Design, build, and deploy AI agents on Google Agent Builder, including prompts, tools/functions, orchestration, and memory.

* Integrate agents with Snowflake, internal systems, and third\-party APIs to enable real task execution.
* Implement retrieval (RAG) against Wild's data to ground agent responses and actions.
* Build evaluation and testing harnesses for agent accuracy, safety, and regression control.
* Instrument observability — logging, tracing, and metrics for agent behaviour and performance.
* Apply guardrails and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns for sensitive or high\-impact actions.

* Support responsible AI practices and governance

 **Required Skills \& Experience**  

* 5\+ years in software engineering with strong full\-stack capability (e.g. Python/TypeScript; React or similar front\-end).
* 3\+ years hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered or agentic applications (tool calling, RAG, orchestration frameworks).
* Practical experience with GCP and ideally Vertex AI / Google Agent Builder.
* Strong API design and systems integration skills.
* Comfort working with data sources such as Snowflake and writing performant SQL.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering, agent evaluation, and safe\-deployment practices.
* Solid software hygiene: Git, CI/CD, testing, and code review.
* Understanding of multi\-agent systems and distributed architectures
* Familiarity with LLMOps / GenAIOps concepts
* Exposure to event\-driven and scalable cloud systems
* Experience in scaling and optimization of LLM systems
* Experience using AI delivery tools like Claude Code, Antigravity etc
 **Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience with agent frameworks/enterprise AI platforms/ orchestration and vector search/embeddings.
* Exposure to cloud cost optimisation / FinOps practices
* GCP associate or professional certification.
* Prior work shipping AI features to real users in production.
* Bachelor's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
 **Key Success Metrics**  

* Agents/features shipped to production and adopted by business users.
* Agent task success rate and reduction in error/escalation rates over time.
* Cycle time from use\-case definition to a deployed, evaluated agent.
* Reliability: defect/incident rate post\-release kept within agreed thresholds.
* Efficiency contribution: measurable reduction in token/compute cost per task through engineering choices.
 **Collaboration \& Stakeholders**  

* Lead Manager – AI Platform \& Engineering (direction and standards).
* Data Engineer (data access and quality).
* FinOps Manager (cost optimisation).
* Business users and process owners who define and validate workflows.
 **Why This Role Matters**  

This role is where AI ambition becomes working automation. By building reliable, well\-governed agents that act on Wild's behalf, the AI Developer directly delivers the capacity gains and productivity improvements that justify the team's existence — moving the business from “AI as an assistant” to “AI that does the work.”

**Description**
 Opportunity: The IN B2B market is made of 63 MM Micro \& Small Customers and 0\.5MM Medium \& Large customers together spending $400B annually. That is the market segment that the Amazon Business team is creating solutions for.
   

  

 Problem: Over the past many years, individual shoppers in India have come to appreciate the convenience, infinite selection and competitive pricing that Amazon offers.
   

  

 While Indian businesses want many of the same benefits listed above, e\-commerce is still not a preferred/ reliable purchase option for them. That is because the needs of the Indian businesses are different from that of individual shoppers and the current state of consumer\-oriented B2C platforms does not fully address the requirements of a business purchase. That is the problem that the PM team at Amazon Business intends to solve. We intend to make buying online as simple, reliable and cost\-effective for businesses as it is for individuals.
   

  

 This means that the PMs in Amazon Business India have to re\-look at every aspect of the customer's journey \- browsing, selection, price display, checkout, payment, delivery and returns experience and enhance them to fir the needs of the business customer. In addition, the team has to build new products \- approval workflows, GST compliance, multi\-user accounts, spend analytics reports etc. to address unique requirements of Indian business customers. We have the same complex problems, ambiguity, fast pace you see in a startup \- but contained within the larger Amazon organization.
   

  

 The Role: This role will own the charter to significantly improve Enterprise procurement experience by partnering with tech teams, global/IN product development teams, marketing, operations, legal, accounting, tax, and finance teams. The roadmap will be a mix of IN first innovations and of IN adaptations of global product features.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is someone who is enthusiastic about managing challenging, ambiguous projects across multiple teams and locations. He or she is comfortable marshaling large amounts of data to make decisions and build business cases.
   

  

 The right candidate will share Amazon's passion for the customer—someone who understands the importance of compelling features and functionalities in driving great customer and seller experience.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**
 CareOps is the platform pod within CareHub that powers how Hinge Health's care team operates at scale. As the PM for CareOps, you'll drive a high\-impact roadmap: improving workload distribution across the care team through algorithmic engine enhancements, migrating complex operational workflows into a modern internal platform, automating member offboarding, and supporting the rollout of new care programs. You'll partner closely with Demand Enablement, Member Ops, Clinical Operations, and a Bangalore\-based engineering team, with significant collaboration with US\-based stakeholders. This role sits within the CareHub neighborhood and reports to the Director of Product for CareHub.
   

  

**What You’ll Accomplish**
* Design the strategy to overhaul our internal tool for workforce management. This includes RBAC, audit logging, and key features like dashboards, dynamic coverage management and more
* Ship improvements to our care team to member assignment engine that improve our care team member workloads.
* Reduce operational average handle time for key workflows
* Define MVPs, set KPIs, and build out a multi quarter roadmap for the CareOps pod with clearly defined success metrics and delivery milestones
* Write high\-quality PRDs and partner with engineering to drive features from discovery to launch with minimal rework


**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of product management experience shipping production features end\-to\-end
* Experience building and iterating on internal tools or operational workflows for non\-technical business users
* Demonstrated ability to write clear, complete PRDs and drive features to launch independently
* Experience with algorithmic systems such as matching, scheduling, routing, or capacity management
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Background in healthcare, digital health, or care operations — or experience with products that serve clinical or ops stakeholders
* Comfortable working with data teams; able to interpret analytical outputs and use them to inform roadmap decisions and measure impact
* Experience collaborating across time zones with US\-based partners from an India location
* Familiarity with microservices architecture and ability to engage on technical trade\-offs with engineering


**Hinge Health Hybrid Model**
 We believe that remote work and in\-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week.
   

  

 This is a Bengaluru\-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA.
 **Time zones:** 
 San Francisco is the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time – for example, 8AM in San Francisco is 8:30 PM in Bengaluru. Standard working hours in San Francisco are between 8AM – 6PM. For this role, applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time.
   

  

**About Hinge Health**
 At Hinge Health, we’re using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare – starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1\.7 billion people worldwide. With an AI\-powered human\-centered care model, Hinge Health leverages cutting\-edge technology to improve outcomes, experiences and costs to help people move beyond their pain. The platform addresses a broad spectrum of MSK care – from acute injury, to chronic pain, to post\-surgical rehabilitation – through personalized, evidence\-based care.
   

  

 As the preferred partner to 50\+ health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 20 million people across more than 2,550 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at http://www.hingehealth.com/
   

  

**What You'll Love About Us**
* Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA).
* Well\-being support: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well\-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally.
* Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions.


**Culture \& Engagement**
 Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.
   

  

 By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the Personnel and Candidate Privacy Policy.
   

  

 Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth.com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth.com.

 Today, through BHN’s single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world’s largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN’s network spans the globe with more than 400,000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN.com.

 BHN operates a card issuance and processing platform that enables both internal and external experiences through API products. You'll own product strategy and execution for our platform APIs—treating them as products with managed roadmaps, developer\-first design, and measurable adoption.

You'll own the full journey: from API design to the customer touchpoints those APIs enable. High exposure role working with engineering, partnerships, and leadership.

* Map and optimize user journeys—understand end\-to\-end experiences from partner integration through customer card usage, identify friction points, drive improvements

* Collaborate with compliance, risk, and operations to meet regulatory and operational standards

* Developer\-centric mindset—you understand API design, integration patterns, what makes great DX

* Continuously identify opportunities to simplify the home loan journey, reduce operational friction, and improve customer, banker, broker, and validator experience.
Promote quality delivery through automation, data\-driven decision\-making, and close collaboration with engineers, analysts, testers, designers, and business SMEs.  
*

**Location:** Bangalore \| Mohali \| Vizag \| Nashik \| Delhi

**About the Role**  


We are looking for a sharp, detail\-oriented RPA Business Analyst to act as the bridge between our clients and automation delivery teams. You will own the discovery\-to\-design journey: identifying automation opportunities, mapping current\-state processes, and defining to\-be solutions that deliver measurable business value.  


This role suits someone who enjoys untangling complex processes, communicating with senior stakeholders, and translating business needs into build\-ready requirements.

* Prepare complete, unambiguous requirement documentation (PDDs/SDDs) and ensure accurate handoff to the development team.

* Document test procedures and UAT scenarios; support business teams through integration, end\-to\-end, and user acceptance testing.
* Support daily RPA operations post go\-live, troubleshooting issues with prompt, practical resolutions.

**Stakeholder Management**  

* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) between clients, project teams, and leadership across the project lifecycle — from requirements gathering through post\-deployment support.
* Manage competing stakeholder priorities and keep all parties aligned on scope, timelines, and outcomes.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Strong command of business process mapping, gap analysis, and process documentation standards.

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* RPA certification (e.g., UiPath Business Analyst, Automation Anywhere Certified Analyst).

* Working knowledge of JIRA, Confluence, or similar project management tools.

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

Join JLL as a Business Operations Analyst and take ownership of the operational backbone that keeps our technology group running smoothly. This is a hands\-on operations role – you'll be the person who makes sure contracts get signed, invoices get paid, contractors get onboarded, and the day\-to\-day machinery of a large technology function works without friction. You'll work closely with technology leadership, finance, HR, and vendor partners to run core operational processes end to end, based out of our Bengaluru office.
  
  

**What your day\-to\-day will look like:**  

**Contracting \& procurement:** manage vendor contracts, statements of work, renewals, and procurement requests, working with Legal and Finance to keep agreements current and compliant.
  
**Invoicing \& payments:** process purchase orders and invoices, track approvals, resolve queries with vendors and Finance, and keep payment cycles on track.
  
**Capex accounting:** track capital expenditure against budget, support month\-end and quarter\-end reconciliation, and maintain accurate capex/opex records for the technology group.
  
**Hiring \& onboarding:** coordinate requisition approvals, support recruitment workflows, and manage new\-hire onboarding logistics in partnership with HR.
  
**Team administration:** own team administration processes – calendars, resourcing trackers, org changes, and general administrative support for the technology group.
  
**Townhalls \& team comms:** plan and run monthly townhalls and other team communications – scheduling, logistics, content coordination, and follow\-up actions.
  
**General operations:** support governance routines, reporting cadences, and other operational processes typical of a technology group, stepping in wherever operational support is needed.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

jobs.description:
**Description**
 Misleading Claims is part of the Regulatory Intelligence Safety and Compliance (RISC) organization. We are on a mission to protect customers from false and deceptive claims on products, enabling trustworthy shopping experiences at Amazon.
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to drive the metrics strategy and data infrastructure for Amazon's Misleading Claims program. This role will define, build, and own the key performance metrics that measure program effectiveness in protecting customers from deceptive product claims across our marketplace. The ideal candidate will independently identify underlying data sources, design new metrics frameworks where none exist, and deliver actionable insights that shape program direction. You will partner with Risk Management, Tech, Science, and Ops teams to translate complex enforcement outcomes into measurable business indicators. Strong analytical judgment, deep SQL proficiency, and experience working with trust and safety or compliance programs are essential. This role requires the ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where data definitions and measurement approaches must be built from the ground up.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will**
* Define and own the end\-to\-end metrics framework for the Misleading Claims program, including identifying gaps in existing measurement, creating new metrics, and establishing baselines and targets for program performance
* Independently identify, evaluate, and onboard underlying data sources across enforcement, detection, and seller behavior systems to build a comprehensive data foundation for program analytics
* Design and build dashboards and reporting mechanisms that provide real\-time visibility into program health, enforcement accuracy, detection coverage, and seller impact
* Independently collaborate across cross\-functional teams – Risk, Legal, Operations, Science, Tech, and Finance – to align on metric definitions, data requirements, and reporting cadences
* Provide data\-driven and actionable insights to senior stakeholders to influence roadmaps, prioritize enforcement strategies, and measure the effectiveness of ML/AI detection models
* Develop key performance indicators that track progress against business objectives, including detection precision/recall, false positive rates, enforcement turnaround times, and seller remediation outcomes
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses on misleading claims trends, abuse patterns, and enforcement outcomes to identify root causes and recommend program improvements
* Build scalable, repeatable analytical processes and self\-service tools that reduce dependency on ad\-hoc analysis and enable the team to make faster, data\-informed decisions


**About The Team**
 Misleading Claims is part of the Regulatory Intelligence Safety and Compliance (RISC) organization, on a mission to protect customers from false and deceptive claims on products, enabling trustworthy shopping experiences at Amazon. As a newly established enforcement program, we're building comprehensive policies, designing enforcement mechanisms, and developing scalable solutions leveraging ML/AI technologies to safeguard customers across our marketplace. Our team collaborates closely with Product Quality, Legal, Tech, Science, and Operations teams to define and execute misleading claims controls at scale. We're establishing success metrics, creating seller education programs, and implementing a risk\-based approach that balances customer protection with seller success. This is an opportunity to shape a critical trust and safety program from the ground up, with direct impact on customer experience and marketplace integrity.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 2\+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
* Experience with Excel
* Experience with SQL


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience partnering with executive\-level leaders to identifying and solving business issues
